Hearty Grabs — a bistro identity.

A logo and storefront board for a bistro that wanted to feel fresh, hearty and handmade. An emblem of cherries and a burger inside a ring — "all natural, kitchen · bakery · catering" — set against a ground of line-drawn produce, in deep green and white.

Branding & graphics — Anirudh Kapoor. A·47.
